description: Fields parsed from the OpenCode go.mdx document and injected into each opencode-go model record in place. No separate go.json is produced. Only fields with a downstream consumer are stored; models.dev already covers the rest.

models.<id>.<field>.note: Injected directly at the top level of each model record (not nested under extra). Fields are cleared for models that disappear from go.mdx. Free models: missing rp5h/usage_quota filled from the largest non-free value; all four price fields forced to 0.

price_input.note: calibrates models.dev cost.input; known drift: glm-5.3-flash is 2x in models.dev (2x-usage billing variant)

price_cached_read.note: calibrates models.dev cost.cache_read; minimax-m2.5 is 2x in models.dev

price_cached_write.note: models.dev omits cache_write entirely for most Go models (e.g. minimax-m2.5/m2.7); mdx is the only source

not_collected.note: Parsed by scripts/parse_opencode_mdx.py but dropped here: no downstream consumer and/or models.dev carries them.

enrich_rule: Go-only model ids with no record in the models.dev opencode-go provider are skipped; the models.dev base (cost, limit, modalities, ...) is preserved untouched.
